name: Scratchpad
description: A sidebar panel to edit one global markdown scratchpad file. It runs as a trusted worker because it reads and writes a single markdown file chosen by the user, outside any workspace.

cover.alt: The Scratchpad panel in Orca's right sidebar, a markdown note with tasks and release steps, beside a Claude Code terminal reading the same note.

screenshots.alt: The dark Scratchpad panel editing a markdown note: a task list, numbered release steps and highlighted Bash and TypeScript blocks.
screenshots.caption: One note, every workspace

screenshots.alt: The same note in Orca's light theme.
screenshots.caption: Follows Orca's theme

screenshots.alt: A Changed elsewhere banner with Keep mine and Reload buttons above the note, after the file changed on disk while it was being edited.
screenshots.caption: Never loses your text

settings.title: Scratchpad file
settings.description: Leave empty to use ~/orca-scratchpad.md. Accepts ~ and must end with .md.
